summary.content:
Today's selection covers 66 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 45 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Musk loses OpenAI court battle after jury finds he waited too long to sue
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: INTERPOL ‘Operation Ramz’ seizes 53 malware, phishing servers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
